tagline: Digital freight marketplace connecting forwarders, carriers and shippers globally
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of bookings on the platform is the primary indicator of growth and marketplace liquidity for the two-sided market, a key driver of strategy and long-term value creation.

risks.title: Insufficient adoption of SaaS software solutions
risks.score_rationale: Ranked first in Item 1A, highly intense language ("severely limited", "stagnate"), upward trend (2026 strategy pivot toward Solutions), critical weight as it conditions future growth and network effects.

risks.title: Critical dependence on diversified user base
risks.score_rationale: Second major risk in Item 1A, very strong language ("significantly hinder", "adversely impact"), stable but structural trend, high weight as it directly affects network effects and platform model viability.

risks.title: History of net losses and lack of profitability
risks.score_rationale: Major risk in Item 1A with quantified data (loss of $17.5M in 2025, $22.5M in 2024), cautious but explicit language ("foreseeable future"), stable but chronic trend, high weight as it limits investment capacity and strategic flexibility.

risks.title: Technology risk: transition to native operations and AI
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in Item 1A ("fundamentally disrupt", "render obsolete"), highly intense language, upward trend (accelerated by AI/ML), high weight as it threatens relevance of existing solutions.

risks.title: Intense competition in the LogTech industry
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in Item 1A ("fiercely competitive LogTech industry"), direct language, stable but structural trend, moderate-to-high weight as it affects ability to maintain or gain market share.

risks.title: Dependence on a limited number of service providers
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in Item 1A ("limited number of sellers"), moderate but clear language, stable trend, moderate weight as it affects quality and diversity of platform offerings.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance and index calculation risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in Item 1A ("accurately calculate freight indexes", "complex regulatory environment"), moderate language ("potential liability"), stable trend, moderate weight as it affects reputation and exposes to penalties.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and cyberattack risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in Item 1A ("cyberattacks and security incidents"), intense language ("numerous adverse impacts"), upward trend (dedicated Item 16K), high weight as it affects user trust and operational continuity.

ai_positioning.summary: No explicit mention of artificial intelligence in the provided documents. The company does not position AI as a strategic or technological lever in its current presentation.
